room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (Silver); Single Private Room (Gold/Platinum ≤7.5L); Any room (Gold/Platinum ≥10L)
room_rent.note: Silver plan: 1% of SI per day excluding cumulative bonus. Gold/Platinum with SI 3L–7.5L: single private AC room. Gold/Platinum SI 10L+: any room. Optional room-rent capping discount available (1.5% of SI/day up to ₹7,500) for Gold/Platinum.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actual charges as provided by the hospital for all plans.

copayment.display: None (base); zone-based co-pay if Zone B/C insured treats in higher zone
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 10% or 20% available for premium discount. Zone B insured treating in Zone A: 15% co-pay; Zone C in Zone A: 20%; Zone C in Zone B: 5%. Loss of Baggage section has mandatory 10% co-pay.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 20% of SI/eye (max ₹1L); Bariatric 25–50% of SI; Maternity fixed limits; Joint Replacement CI sub-limit ₹5L
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 20% of SI per eye max ₹1L. Bariatric: 25% SI (Silver), 50% SI max ₹5L (Gold/Platinum). Maternity: ₹15k/₹25k normal, ₹25k/₹35k caesarean depending on SI. Critical Illness Joint Replacement sub-limited to ₹5L if SI >₹5L.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Voluntary aggregate deductible options: ₹50,000 / ₹1,00,000 / ₹2,00,000 / ₹3,00,000 available for premium discount. Not applicable on maternity/newborn claims.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement. Not applicable for accidents. Waived if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reduced to extent of prior coverage under portability norms.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Health Guard section has 24-month waiting for listed conditions (cataracts, hernia, fistula, BPH, haemorrhoids, stones, etc.). Hospital Cash section has 12-month waiting for its listed conditions. Additional 36-month waiting for joint replacement, vertebral surgery, bariatric, Parkinson's, genetic disorders.

maternity.display: Covered – Gold & Platinum plans only (72-month wait)
maternity.note: Maternity covered under Gold and Platinum plans only. 72-month waiting period from first policy inception. Normal delivery: ₹15k–₹25k; Caesarean: ₹25k–₹35k depending on SI. Max 2 deliveries/terminations. Pre/post-natal (90 days) within maternity limit. Not covered under Silver plan.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (10%/yr) – Silver & Gold; Up to 150% – Platinum
cumulative_bonus.note: Silver & Gold: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100% over 10 years. Reduced by 10% on a claim year. Platinum: Super Cumulative Bonus – 50%/yr for first 2 years then 10%/yr for next 5 years, max 150% of SI.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement: 100% of base SI reinstated once per policy year after full exhaustion of SI including cumulative bonus. Triggered only after complete exhaustion. For Cancer and Kidney Failure, applicable only once in lifetime; for other conditions, every year. Platinum plan also has Recharge Benefit (20% of SI up to ₹5L) if claim exceeds SI.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 60 days before hospitalisation for the same illness/injury.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 90 days after discharge for the same illness/injury.

day_care.display: Covered – listed procedures (extensive list in Annexure I)
day_care.note: Day care procedures covered as per indicative list in Annexure I covering ENT, ophthalmology, oncology, urology, orthopaedics, gynaecology and more.

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary hospitalisation benefit mentioned in the Health Guard section wording.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to the Sum Insured in government or accredited AYUSH hospitals. Minimum 24-hour admission required.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered provided the organ is for the insured person and the insured's hospitalisation claim is accepted.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹20,000 per policy year for emergency transfer to nearest hospital or transfer between hospitals. Payable only when hospitalisation claim is accepted.

modern_treatments.note: Modern treatments per Annexure III (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, deep brain stimulation, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, etc.) covered up to base SI subject to policy terms.

consumables.display: Not covered (extensive non-medical items list excluded)
consumables.note: Annexure II lists extensive non-medical/consumable items not payable (gloves, masks, syringes, diapers, crepe bandages, etc.). No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only. No international/overseas cover available.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested on grounds of non-disclosure/misrepresentation except proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes. Continuity benefits maintained during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy document for new individual policies only. Not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Must apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment; external congenital anomalies; growth hormone therapy; refractive error <7.5D; mental illness has 24-mo wait; no domiciliary cover

optional_riders.display: Air Ambulance (SI ≥5L); Voluntary co-pay (10%/20% for premium discount); Voluntary aggregate deductible; Room rent capping discount; Zone-based premium
